title: Simulation 3D Dolly
text: Implement dolly in 3D environment, 2 inputs, {Type} sets Type One-axle; {Name}, {Sample time}, {Initial array values to translate vehicle per part, Translation} sets the vehicle initial translation zeros and {Initial array values to rotate vehicle per part, Rotation} sets the initial rotation zeros. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Type
params.values: Type One-axle dolly (default) | Two-axle dolly | Three-axle dolly

params.name: Name
params.values: Name of dolly SimulinkVehicle1 (default) | character vector

params.name: Initial array values to translate vehicle per part, Translation
params.values: Vehicle initial translation zeros( 5, 3 ) (default) | zeros( 8, 3 ) | zeros( 11, 3 )

params.name: Initial array values to rotate vehicle per part, Rotation
